10. Run owner-authorized autonomous QA.
11. Run owner-authorized autonomous deployment.
12. Verify GitHub SHA = API SHA = worker SHA = /version SHA.
13. Verify replay rejection.
14. Return authorization ID, job ID, CI run ID, deployment IDs, proof-ledger ID, and final PASS/FAIL.

Do not ask for the token again.
Do not print the token.
